items.stem: Name one directional growth movement each in response to chemicals and water in plants. Write an example for each of them.
items.answer:
Chemotropism and hydrotropism are the directional growth movements in response to chemicals and water respectively.
Chemotropism example – growth of pollen tube towards the ovule.
Hydrotropism example – growth of roots towards water.
